acceptance.given: A legitimate child dependency is missing when the public entry is invoked.

oracle.expected: The public entry reports or otherwise exposes the missing child dependency as unmet, and no installation or provisioning action is performed implicitly.
forbidden: The public entry silently installs a missing child.
The dependency appears satisfied without an explicit installation or provisioning action.
oracle.observable: At the public entry boundary, the result or diagnostic identifies the missing child dependency and the dependency remains unmet unless an explicit installation or provisioning action occurs.

acceptance.then: The missing child remains an explicit unmet dependency at the entry boundary, and no implicit installation occurs.
acceptance.when: The public entry processes the missing-child case and its observable result is evaluated.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure the public entry exposes missing child dependencies explicitly and never silently installs or satisfies them.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; reverting the entry behavior restores prior invocation semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Missing child dependency remains unmet and is surfaced at the entry boundary until an explicit installation or provisioning action is supplied.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected test or equivalent validator observes an explicit missing-child report and confirms no implicit installation or provisioning occurred.
